insights.one_liner: Aviclaim helps travellers claim compensation for delayed and cancelled flights and is expanding across Europe; its Utrecht business development job needs no Dutch.

culture.text: Handles flight delay and cancellation compensation claims, aiming to make them fair and stress-free.

open.text: Not listed as an IND recognised visa sponsor.
Its one current job here, a business development role in Utrecht, does not require Dutch.

growth.text: Says it is expanding across Europe and wants a business development manager to launch new markets.
